verdict.rationale: Nothing in the first-party docs describes configuring a Cua agent to use a custom or OpenAI-compatible model endpoint. The docs instead cover Cua Driver plugging into external agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) and SDK runtimes. One community report mentions running cua-agent with gemma3:4b, but it is an anecdotal run with no documented configuration, so it does not establish the capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can point the agent at my own model endpoint (OpenAI-compatible or otherwise) through documented configuration
